t: This is Phillipa Lepley, a couture atelier in London making bespoke wedding dresses and eveningwear. The house carries the name of its founder, Phillipa Lepley, a British fashion designer and couturier who established it in 1986. She is still its creative director. So the name over the door is the person who started the business, owns it, and leads its design, and the work here is made to order rather than bought off a rail.
